name: iFlight LC Filter · 16 × 6 seller version · reference
description: Selected seller version with an adopted 16 × 6 × 3 mm external envelope. The 1 mm PCB thickness, 0.35 mm corners and central 10 × 4 × 2 mm component volume are unverified. Native Z0 is the assumed board underside. No mounting holes, terminal coordinates or wire geometry are invented. Do not substitute the larger current iFlight revision without checking its fit. Confirm the delivered revision, copper-free retaining lands, solder joints, insulation and component height. The model does not qualify filter behavior, electrical ratings or the completed circuit.
